name: Riofrío (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a diagonal band of three white and two blue wavy stripes from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Riofrío (a wavy river between two bulls on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved by decree on 13 February 1996 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 42 of 28 February 1996); the flag is described as square, tierced in bend, the first and third green and the second barry wavy of three white and two blue, with the municipal arms over all at the centre.
